outstanding_asks.ask: Fix the keyed foreach example: todo_row requires index and does not accept key; put key on the component returned by a callback that supplies both arguments.
Clarify that on_mount=count.set(index) resets only when a row mounts and does not follow later index changes under positional keys.
Correct the wrapping-react example so it does not imply on_mount state follows later item changes; key the row or document an explicit update.
Qualify the root release note: foreach inside an explicit @rx.memo body does not automatically provide per-item unnamed client state.
Replace the object-identity assertion between separately split strings with a value or export-name assertion that proves separate memo blocks were emitted.
Fix the identity-key docs examples so the render callback supplies index and puts key on the returned component rather than passing key to todo_row.
Memoize the ScopedValues context chain when parent and provided entries are Object.is-equal so unchanged memoized item consumers do not re-render.
Qualify the reflex-base release note with the explicit @rx.memo exception to per-item unnamed client state.
Fix the earlier docs example that calls an undefined row and passes key through the wrong helper signature.
Make the foreach docs explicitly state that on_mount reset does not track later index changes under positional keys, matching the wrapping-react correction.
Fix or acknowledge the six current-head benchmark regressions reported by CodSpeed.

failing_job_findings.cause: CodSpeed reports six regressions against the stacked base: four _stateful_page compilation benchmarks regressed 14.23%-15.8%, two _stateful_page evaluation benchmarks regressed 5.71%-6.24%, and read_cached_computed regressed 4.16%. Diagnostics say all six significant base/head measurements used different hardware and warn about omitted system-call time.
